name: Shiki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shiki city emblem in red: a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shiki, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 26 October 1970.

features.role: Shiki city emblem — a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised character
